title: Coinbase Exits Argentina: Peso-to-USDC Trading Ends January 2026
summary: Coinbase withdraws peso-to-USDC trading from Argentina by January 31, barely a year after launching with regulatory approval, while crypto-to-crypto operations continue amid evolving regulatory framework and market repositioning. The post Coinbase Exits Argentina: Peso-to-USDC Trading Ends January 2026 appeared first on Cryptonews .
